_about: A layout is cleaned before it is drafted, checked and matched (api/src/sms_v2/draft_layout.js; the phone's smsCleanLayout in packages/pandapay_domain/lib/src/sms_v2/template/skeleton.dart must give the same result, tests read this file on both sides). Cleaning: odd tags <AMOUNT>/<ACCOUNT> become <AMT>/<MASK>; a bare @handle (not an e-mail) becomes <W>; a long token mixing letters with # digits (an ID) becomes <W>. Blanks are never merged. Idempotent. The template hash is always of the ORIGINAL layout.

entries.name: odd tags
entries.layout: Your Canara Bank account <ACCOUNT> debited for INR <AMOUNT> on <DATE>.
entries.clean: Your Canara Bank account <MASK> debited for INR <AMT> on <DATE>.

entries.name: handle
entries.layout: Dear Customer, shop everything on EMI @Flipkart with your Kotak Debit Card.
entries.clean: Dear Customer, shop everything on EMI <W> with your Kotak Debit Card.

entries.name: handle with a name tag
entries.layout: <AMT> spent on YES BANK Card <MASK> @UPI_<PARTY> <DATE> ##:##:## pm.
entries.clean: <AMT> spent on YES BANK Card <MASK> <W> <DATE> ##:##:## pm.

entries.name: an e-mail-like text is not a handle
mixed id
entries.layout: Your transaction for <AMT> against txn ID mvtHfGfdjLvdwwKyVa#pF# has been processed successfully. -Kotak
entries.clean: Your transaction for <AMT> against txn ID <W> has been processed successfully. -Kotak

entries.name: short code with digits is not an id
entries.layout: <AMT> debited at <PARTY> OCT## via UPI. Ref DV#####.
entries.clean: <AMT> debited at <PARTY> OCT## via UPI. Ref DV#####.

entries.name: blanks are never merged
entries.layout: Dear <PARTY>, application <PARTY> of <PARTY> has been accepted.
entries.clean: Dear <PARTY>, application <PARTY> of <PARTY> has been accepted.
